intro: Trying to find Illinois scholarships for financial need without sorting through larger national awards first? This filtered USA view narrows the search to programs with listed awards under five thousand dollars, making it easier to compare smaller grants, community-focused scholarships, and subject-based options in one place. The rows here span areas such as education, STEM, medicine, disability, and broader miscellaneous or community categories, with examples that reach from high school seniors to college and graduate students. Award amounts vary by listing, and requirements, essay expectations, residency details, and deadline timing can differ from one program to the next. Because date text appears across these listings and some deadlines may be coming up soon, it is smart to check each row promptly before you apply.
